Container.Name: mcp-memory
Container.Overview: Persistent AI memory service with semantic search. SQLite-vec backend, HTTP/SSE transport. For Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP clients. Bridge mode -- publishes port to LAN.
Container.Description:
Deploys doobidoo/mcp-memory-service with SQLite-vec backend on standard bridge networking. Port 8000 is published to the host for LAN access. Suitable for single-user or trusted-LAN deployments. For remote access, pair with the Tailscale sidecar variant or a Cloudflare Tunnel.
Generate an API key before starting: openssl rand -base64 48 Configure MCP_API_KEY in the template before first launch.
First boot downloads a ~90MB ONNX embedding model and can appear to hang for several minutes -- watch the container log for download progress.
Healthcheck queries /api/health every 30 seconds. Container will show "unhealthy" in Unraid Docker if the HTTP service crashes inside.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: MCP HTTP/SSE service port. Clients connect here.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: SQLite-vec database directory. Contains memory.db and WAL files.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Nightly SQLite dump output. Point host-level backup tools here.

Config.Name: MCP API Key
Config.Description: Bearer token for all requests. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID. Default 99 (nobody) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID. Default 100 (users) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: HTTP Enabled
Config.Description: Enable HTTP server. Must be true for network access.

Config.Name: HTTP Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal listening port. Change only if port 8000 conflicts.

Config.Name: Storage Backend
Config.Description: Vector backend. sqlite_vec is recommended. Other options: chroma, hybrid.

Config.Name: SQLite Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside container. Must be inside the data volume.

Config.Name: Backups Path
Config.Description: Container path for backup dumps. Must match backup volume mount.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity. INFO for normal, DEBUG for troubleshooting.

Config.Name: OAuth Enabled
Config.Description: Enable native OAuth 2.1. Not needed if using Cloudflare Access or LAN-only.

Config.Name: OAuth Secret Key
Config.Description: JWT signing secret for OAuth. Only needed if MCP_OAUTH_ENABLED=true. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
